title: OpenStax free textbooks
licence_note: Free to read online and download. OpenStax states most books use CC BY-NC-SA; a few use CC BY, so check each book's own page. Credit OpenStax when you reuse.
subject: Open textbooks across subjects

title: MIT OpenCourseWare
licence_note: Free and open collection of MIT course materials under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. No sign-up needed. No credit or certificate.
subject: University course materials

title: NPTEL: courses from the IITs and IISc
licence_note: Courses are free to learn from. A certificate needs a proctored exam with a separate fee. Linked, not copied.
subject: Engineering and science video courses

title: SWAYAM: national online courses
licence_note: Courses are free to learners. A SWAYAM certificate needs a proctored exam, which has a fee.
subject: Online courses, school to postgraduate

title: NCERT textbooks on ePathshala
licence_note: NCERT offers its textbooks free to read and download. Link to them; do not re-host.
subject: School textbooks (classes I to XII)

title: National Digital Library of India (NDLI)
licence_note: No fee to access the library. Each item has its own access label (open, subscribed, authorised, limited); only items marked open are free for everyone.
subject: Books, articles, videos and theses

title: Shodhganga: Indian theses and dissertations
licence_note: Full texts of Indian theses in open access for the academic community under UGC regulations. Cite thesis and author.
subject: Indian research theses

title: DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals
licence_note: A free index of open access journals. Each journal sets its own licence, shown on its page.
subject: Open access journals

title: Project Gutenberg
licence_note: Nearly all books are public domain in the United States. Copyright rules differ by country, so check local law before reuse.
subject: Classic literature and older books
